course.title: Unit 7 Happy Birthday!【例句】
course.description: SECTION A How do we celebrate birthdays?

sentences.content: So can you come to my birthday party?
sentences.english: So can you come to my birthday party ?
sentences.chinese: 那你能来参加我的生日派对吗？

sentences.content: Ella, can you help me? I want to give my father a birthday gift.
sentences.english: Ella , can you help me ? I want to give my father a birthday gift
sentences.chinese: Ella，你能帮我吗？我想给我父亲送一份生日礼物。

sentences.content: Oh, that's sweet, Teng Fei! When is his birthday?
sentences.english: Oh , that's sweet , Teng Fei ! When is his birthday ?
sentences.chinese: 哦，真贴心，Teng Fei！他的生日是什么时候？

sentences.content: That's soon! You can make a card for him.
sentences.english: That's soon ! You can make a card for him
sentences.chinese: 这么快！你可以给他做张卡片。

sentences.content: Meimei, when is Ms Gao's birthday?
sentences.english: Meimei , when is Ms Gao's birthday ?
sentences.chinese: Meimei，高女士的生日是什么时候？

sentences.content: Because I want us all to give her a surprise.
sentences.english: Because I want us all to give her a surprise
sentences.chinese: 因为我想让我们大家一起给她一个惊喜。

sentences.content: Sounds fun! Her birthday is on 12th June.
sentences.english: Sounds fun ! Her birthday is on 12th June
sentences.chinese: 听起来很有趣！她的生日是6月12日。

wordDetails.definition: sound（第三人称单数）: 听起来

sentences.content: Let's sing a song for her. I'll play the guitar.
sentences.english: Let's sing a song for her . I'll play the guitar
sentences.chinese: 让我们为她唱首歌吧，我来弹吉他。

sentences.content: Hi, Peter! It's Ella and Emma's birthday soon. How about a surprise party for them?
sentences.english: Hi , Peter ! It's Ella and Emma's birthday soon . How about a surprise party for them ?
sentences.chinese: 嗨，Peter！Ella和Emma的生日快到了。给她们办个惊喜派对怎么样？

sentences.content: Good idea! Let's go and buy something for the party.
sentences.english: Good idea ! Let's go and buy something for the party
sentences.chinese: 好主意！我们去买些派对用的东西吧。

sentences.content: Good morning. Can I help you?
sentences.english: Good morning . Can I help you ?
sentences.chinese: 早上好。有什么可以帮您的吗？

sentences.content: Yes, please. How much is this birthday cake?
sentences.english: Yes , please . How much is this birthday cake ?
sentences.chinese: 好的，麻烦问下这个生日蛋糕多少钱？

sentences.content: We have a sale today. It's 85 yuan, and it comes with some candles.
sentences.english: We have a sale today . It's 85 yuan , and it comes with some candles
sentences.chinese: 我们今天有促销活动。价格是85元，还附赠一些蜡烛。

sentences.content: How many kilos do you want?
sentences.english: How many kilos do you want ?

sentences.content: Teng Fei, how about some yogurt?
sentences.english: Teng Fei , how about some yogurt ?

sentences.content: Thank you! Have a nice day!
sentences.english: Thank you ! Have a nice day !
sentences.chinese: 谢谢！祝您有美好的一天！
